nodes.speaker: Kella
nodes.text: The egg hatched. A tiny dragon stares up at you with enormous, blinking eyes.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [It opens its mouth and makes a sound approximately like: 'mrrp.']

nodes.prompt: What will you name the baby dragon?

nodes.speaker: Kella
nodes.text: '{baby_dragon_name},' she says. The dragon makes the mrrp sound again.

nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.text: [{baby_dragon_name} joins the party. They are unreasonably small for how dangerous they will become.]
